_why_a_file_and_not_a_dispatch_input: A workflow_dispatch can only be dispatched once the workflow file exists on the DEFAULT branch, and this lane may not push to main. A `push:` trigger, by contrast, runs from the pushed branch with no default-branch dependency (the same mechanism gpu-protfep-vast.yml uses). Committing a change to THIS file is therefore how a task is launched from a feature branch, and it leaves a git-auditable record of every run that was fired. Once the workflow reaches main, `workflow_dispatch` inputs override this file.

_tasks.noop: do nothing (the safe default; a push that only touches unrelated files never fires GPU work)
_tasks.selftest: $0 CI. Import + unit checks of the lane's pure helpers, and a dry-run JobSpec
_tasks.smoke: ~$0.10. One host, toy lengths, the WHOLE chain metad -> release -> export -> S3
_tasks.launch: the real matched ensembles, one interruptible host each, concurrently. `launch_targets` restricts WHICH legs are rented (a relaunch of one leg must not re-rent a healthy sibling); `targets` still governs watch/collect/analyse.
_tasks.status: $0. Vast instance board + S3 phase markers + the tail of each run.log
_tasks.collect: $0. Pull the frame tarballs from S3, unpack into results/nr4a{1,2}-pocket-ensemble, commit
_tasks.analyse: $0. Run nr4a_paralogue_dynamics.py over whatever ensembles are present and commit the JSON
_tasks.reap: $0. Destroy instances whose result is already in S3, or which are terminal/over the backstop
_tasks.watch: $0. ONE long CI run that polls S3 every 3 min with a real PROGRESS check, nudges a stuck start, destroys a host that answers resources_unavailable, RE-RENTS a leg that died with no deliverable (bounded), reaps finished hosts, and fails on a stall. Monitoring that survives a session death.

note: INTERIM analysis while both GPU legs run. It commits the NR4A3-side result -- which reproduces the committed handle-ensemble numbers exactly (C397 at the 12-atom gate in 96 % of 75 unbiased frames, C420 and C559 in 0 %) and extends them to EVERY cysteine -- plus the static paralogue models. The paralogue-dynamics scopes are marked VERDICT_NOT_EVALUABLE rather than reported as a clean 0, because with no paralogue conformers the collision probability is 0 by construction. Live legs: NR4A1 45853652 and NR4A2 45854620, both RTX 4090, both advancing; NR4A1 measured at ~143-160 ns/day across four DCD-derived points, so ~12.6 h per leg.

estimate_usd.basis: smoke leg implied ~234 ns/day on a rented RTX 4090; 75 ns of MD per paralogue (60 ns metad + 3 x 5 ns release); bid $0.136/hr actually paid against a $0.1333 floor; 60 GB at the $0.20/GB/month median storage rate; two hosts concurrently
